## Spec

GarageBucketSpec defines the desired state of GarageBucket

| Field path | Type | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clusterRef` | object | required | ClusterRef references the GarageCluster this bucket belongs to |
| `clusterRef.kubeConfigSecretRef` | object |  | KubeConfigSecretRef references a secret containing kubeconfig for a remote cluster. Only used for cross-cluster references in multi-cluster federation scenarios. |
| `clusterRef.kubeConfigSecretRef.key` | string | required | The key of the secret to select from. Must be a valid secret key. |
| `clusterRef.kubeConfigSecretRef.name` | string | default: "" | Name of the referent. This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are almost certainly wrong. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names |
| `clusterRef.kubeConfigSecretRef.optional` | boolean |  | Specify whether the Secret or its key must be defined |
| `clusterRef.name` | string | required | Name of the GarageCluster |
| `clusterRef.namespace` | string |  | Namespace of the GarageCluster (defaults to the same namespace as the referencing resource) |
| `deletionPolicy` | string | default: "Delete"; enum: \["Delete", "Retain"\] | DeletionPolicy controls whether deleting this resource also deletes the corresponding Garage bucket. The default is Delete. |
| `globalAlias` | string |  | GlobalAlias is the global alias for this bucket (optional) If not set, the bucket name from metadata.name is used |
| `keyPermissions` | array of object |  | KeyPermissions grants access to specific GarageKeys. Note: Permissions can be granted from either direction: - Here (GarageBucket.keyPermissions): Grant keys access to this bucket - On GarageKey (GarageKey.bucketPermissions): Grant the key access to buckets Both approaches are equivalent and result in the same Garage API calls. Use whichever is more convenient for your workflow: - Bucket-centric: Define all key access on the bucket - Key-centric: Define all bucket access on the key If the same permission is defined in both places, they are merged (not conflicting). |
| `keyPermissions[].keyRef` | string | required | KeyRef references the GarageKey by name |
| `keyPermissions[].owner` | boolean |  | Owner allows bucket owner operations |
| `keyPermissions[].read` | boolean |  | Read allows reading objects |
| `keyPermissions[].write` | boolean |  | Write allows writing objects |
| `localAliases` | array of object |  | LocalAliases are per-key local aliases for this bucket |
| `localAliases[].alias` | string | required | Alias is the local alias name |
| `localAliases[].keyRef` | string | required | KeyRef references the GarageKey |
| `quotas` | object |  | Quotas configures bucket quotas |
| `quotas.maxObjects` | integer | format: "int64" | MaxObjects is the maximum number of objects |
| `quotas.maxSize` | integer or string | pattern: "^(\\+\|-)?((\[0-9\]+(\\.\[0-9\]*)?)\|(\\.\[0-9\]+))((\[KMGTPE\]i)\|\[numkMGTPE\]\|(\[eE\](\\+\|-)?((\[0-9\]+(\\.\[0-9\]*)?)\|(\\.\[0-9\]+))))?$" | MaxSize is the maximum bucket size in bytes |
| `website` | object |  | Website configures static website hosting for this bucket. Note: Only indexDocument and errorDocument are supported via the Admin API. For advanced features (routing rules, redirectAll), use S3 PutBucketWebsite API directly. |
| `website.enabled` | boolean |  | Enabled enables static website hosting |
| `website.errorDocument` | string |  | ErrorDocument is the error document to serve for 404s |
| `website.indexDocument` | string | default: "index.html" | IndexDocument is the default index document (default: index.html) |
